name: The Chrome Trial: Uncut Proceedings, 2199
description: A raw, unedited compilation of leaked recordings from the closed Axiom internal tribunal investigating illegal augmentation testing on the Gray Zone populations between 2193 and 2198 — the so-called 'chrome trials' in which experimental neural-chromatic augmentation was administered to the Gray Zone residents through contaminated water filtration systems without consent or disclosure. The documentary adds no narration, no music, and no editorial framing — only timestamps and the voices of Axiom executives discussing acceptable casualty thresholds. It is considered the most dangerous piece of media in circulation in GLMZ.
cultural_impact: The phrase 'acceptable threshold' became a piece of the Gray Zone slang meaning any official lie, entering the vernacular so thoroughly that even Tier 3 residents use it without knowing its origin.
story_hooks: A voice in the recordings belongs to someone who is currently a beloved public figure in Axiom's community outreach program.
A character receives a copy with a specific timestamp highlighted — the timestamp corresponds to the date of a family member's unexplained illness.
Someone is offering significant Quanta to anyone who can prove the recordings are fabricated, which raises the question of who benefits from that proof.
